headline: Peruvian sol trades steadily at 3.45 per dollar ahead of US Federal Reserve decision
summary: The Peruvian sol opened at S/ 3.450 per US dollar in Lima's interbank market, staying near its previous close of S/ 3.451 as traders awaited the Federal Reserve's rate announcement.
why: Emerging market currencies often experience fluctuations tied to expectations regarding US monetary policy and global dollar liquidity.
